question.text: The depository must take adequate measures including _________ to protect the interests of beneficial owners against various types of risks.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the depository should take adequate measures including insurance to protect the interests of beneficial owners against various types of risks. The Trap: 'Guarantees from the central government' is not how depository risk protection is described — the workbook names insurance as the adequate protective measure. Note: Insurance is the source-named protective measure; specific coverage examples are not detailed in the depository pages cited.
